title: Best for extra/add-on use.. not everyday!
text:
Best for extra/add-on use.. not everyday!. With x4 adult children and now significant others, bff, roommates… We’ve found ourselves needing to expand our kitchenware for holiday or family BBQ’s- truly, anytime we all gather! We love to host bringing in all the extras and realized- our original set of x6 knives will not suffice any longer!! With the Farberware triple riveted steak knives I hoped for an easy and economical solution. What we found was a set best used in an add-on capacity.. but just not for every day!

Knives provide a sharpness so I’m not unhappy.. but, I found these a bit less productive than even our decade-old knife set. The good news is.. I plan to keep them sharp and guest ready.. not put into everyday play. That way knives hold onto their ability they came with. At $13 for 8.. I feel I really can’t complain.

Knife has a solid fit in the hand to give the user control- blade has a sharpness but, I do find it a bit uneven.. it doesn’t appear to have the same sharpness all the way across? Tbh, I’ve notice this with x3 of the 8. So, maybe a quirk?? Knife has good balance which allows you to apply cutting pressure- see photos included above. Used with chicken, pork and steak these knives have done their job to about 85% of satisfaction.. and again, for the price point I’m not disappointed.

Overall, a set best used in extra capacity. If keeping realistic expectations you won’t be let down.. Knife is solidly made knife from a trusted brand- Hoping info can help your decision.. stay safe everyone!

product_metadata.title: Farberware Full-Tang Triple-Riveted 8-Piece Steak Knife Set, High-Carbon Stainless Steel, Razor-Sharp Knives with Ergonomic Handle, Kitchen Knives, Set of 8, Black
features: KITCHEN ESSENTIALS: This Farberware 8-piece Steak Knife set is perfect for everyday use. These knives knives easily cut through steaks and thick chops.
HIGH QUALITY BLADE: Each knife features a high-carbon, stainless steel blade which ensure the knife retains its ultra-sharp edge.
STYLISH HANDLE: Ergonomically designed for a comfortable grip; each knife is perfectly balanced for precision while cutting.
SET INCLUDES: 8-piece set includes: (8) 4-1/2 inch steak knives
EASY CARE: Farberware knives should be hand-washed with warm water and a mild detergent. Rinse and dry immediately. Stainless steel knives are not dishwasher safe. Lifetime limited warranty.
